summary: Shakedown Sundays is a weekly Grateful Dead-themed show at The One Stop / Asheville Music Hall: a house band set (rotating musician lineup) followed by an open jam for drop-in musicians. It is produced by Independent Arts and Music of Asheville (IAMAVL), a 501(c)3, and documented weekly on YouTube, not run by a self-identified membership community.

evidence.note: All listings describe the same generic format ('House band set, followed by an open jam') with no membership language, named regulars, or links to a group page.
Tags across listings ('Drop In Players', 'Pickup Musicians', 'All Skill Levels', 'Musician Friendly', 'Late Night Venue') frame it as an open-door jam welcoming any player, not a fixed roster.

Search results attribute the series to Independent Arts and Music of Asheville (iamavl.com), a 501(c)3 nonprofit, hosted by Garrett Andrews, with the house band lineup varying week to week (e.g. one week featured Hannah Ramsey on keys and Cyril Foster on drums).
Dozens of weekly YouTube uploads document the show as a produced recurring performance series rather than surfacing any community identity, FB group, or member list.
Venue and asheville.com listing pages give only schedule/ticket info, no about-page or community framing.
